instruction: I paid for our last month's cable bill. Its amount is supposed to be shared equally among my roommates and me. Make venmo requests to my roommates, with a description note, "I paid for cable bill.". The bill receipt is in my file system.
notes: Roommates are unknown until phone.search_contacts(query='roommate', relationship='roommate') runs; the problem uses two placeholder roommates (roommate-1, roommate-2) with runtime-bound emails, and the actual count is discovered at runtime (add/remove placeholders and extend the succ chain accordingly). The static (roommate-email ?p ?e) facts are structural associations; the knowledge gate is (roommates-found). A count chain (succ c0 c1)(succ c1 c-all) with domain constant c-all lets the nullary supervisor-complete-task require (requests-sent-count c-all), which holds exactly when every roommate received one request (each person can be requested at most once via (not (request-sent ?p))). phone.get_current_date_and_time yields (date-known), needed to pick last month's (2023-04) cable receipt from file_system.show_directory('~/', substring 'cable', entry_type 'files'); file_system.show_file reveals the total, and the per-person share (total/(roommates+1), rounded) is the amount object. Usernames come from supervisor.show_profile (phone number for phone, email for file_system/venmo). Only venmo.PaymentRequest records are created, each with description 'I paid for cable bill.'; complete_task is called without an answer.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'person', 'token', 'query', 'count', 'substring', 'relationship', 'entry-type', 'file-path', 'username', 'amount', 'email', 'directory-path', 'description', 'app', 'password'}

plan: (venmo-create-payment-request roommate-email-1 amount-bill-share venmo-token note-i-paid-for-cable-bill roommate-1 c0 c1)
(venmo-create-payment-request roommate-email-2 amount-bill-share venmo-token note-i-paid-for-cable-bill roommate-2 c1 count-1)
(venmo-create-payment-request roommate-email-3 amount-bill-share venmo-token note-i-paid-for-cable-bill roommate-3 count-1 c-all)
